# Driftpost

> One calm composer for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and X. Pick a brand, drop one file, tune each platform, publish everywhere.

## What it does

Driftpost is a brand-first publishing console for agencies, studios and creators. Connect YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and X once per brand, then post to all four from a single guided composer with per-platform titles, tags, captions, polls and links. Direct publishing only — nothing is scheduled or automated.
